title: SSL/TLS Only and Authenticated App: restore discoverability as dedicated wizard tiles or depth sub-options
goal: Live audit confirmed that ssl-tls and authenticated-app are not present as standalone wizard tiles (tile grid shows 10 tiles; ssl-tls and authenticated-app are absent). The depth options for External Web are only Passive / Active Scan / Full Pentest — no SSL/TLS Only or Authenticated App sub-option. Operators wanting a TLS certificate audit or an authenticated web application scan have no clear self-service path. Fix with one of these approaches in priority order: (1) Add ssl-tls and authenticated-app back as tiles in the ASSESSMENT_TILE_OPTIONS array in wizard.js with appropriate icons, descriptions, and phase tags — preferred. (2) If tile addition causes layout issues, add them as depth sub-options under External Web tile: alongside Passive/Active/Full Pentest, add 'SSL/TLS Only' and 'Authenticated' depth cards. Do not remove or change any existing tile or depth option.
